FAQ

Questions Buyers Ask Us First

Are you a factory?

No. We are a sourcing company. That means we work for you, not for one factory.

What is the MOQ?

From 100 pcs for trial orders. We negotiate MOQ down by combining small runs.

How do you ensure quality?

Three checkpoints, an AQL 2.5 pre-shipment inspection, and a photo report you approve before we ship.

How do you get paid?

30% deposit, balance before shipment. Or via Alibaba Trade Assurance.

Can you do custom logo and packaging?

Yes — OEM/ODM through our partner factories, with a free logo mockup within 48 hours.

About Funsu — Your Sourcing Team in China

10 years in pet supplies export & sourcing: supplier screening, quality control and consolidated shipping under one roof.

Company Story

We Don't Own Factories — We Manage Them

We are a pet product sourcing and supply chain company based in China. Working with vetted manufacturers across Zhejiang and Guangdong, we match your product to the right factory, manage sampling, inspect before shipment, and handle export logistics.

You keep control. We handle the messy part.

After years of working in pet product manufacturing and export, we saw a gap: small and medium buyers struggled to find reliable suppliers with flexible MOQ and professional quality control.

Funsu was founded to bridge that gap. Because we are factory-independent, we recommend the supplier that fits your order best — not our own production line. We are your eyes and ears on the ground, from sample approval to container loading.

Supplier Screening

Strict 3-Step Quality Screening

We audit 20+ suppliers to select the top 3 for your products.

Document Audit

Business licenses, export history and certificates verified for every candidate factory.

Sample Evaluation

Samples from shortlisted factories tested and compared before any order is placed.

Trial Order

A small supervised trial run proves capacity and consistency before scaling up.

Quality Control

100% Pre-Shipment Inspection

Every order is inspected before it ships, so you receive exactly what you approved.

Specification & AQL

We confirm all details and set AQL standards before production starts.

During Production

Regular updates and live video checks you can join remotely.

Final Inspection

Random sampling, functional testing and packaging checks with calibrated tools.

Third-Party Option

For critical orders we arrange SGS / Intertek / Bureau Veritas at transparent cost.

Inspection Process
